_comment: Measured on the unmodified legacy code over 6 GPU runs (Phase 1 + 2a). Every stage is bit-exact run to run except those combined with tfmri Walsh coil maps, whose eigenvector phase is unanchored: worst observed |mag diff| 1.7e-5, worst sign-invariant complex diff 7.6e-3 (signal max ~1). Thresholds ~5x / ~2.5x the worst observed. Never loosen these to make a refactor pass; upstream stages must stay exact.
